visual_description: A small, palm-sized device in 'Rescue Orange' high-impact plastic. It has a flip-up antenna and a single large button protected by a 'break-away' clear plastic cover. A small LED is flashing green, indicating 'Armed'. It is clipped to the shoulder strap of a dusty field pack.

constraints.material: Textured orange polycarbonate; stainless steel belt clip.
constraints.logic: The ultimate safety tool. Used only in 'Critical Failure' states.
